automation_evidence.quote: We introduce NeuroAct, an autonomous research agent framework for EEG analysis and decoding.

metric_evidence.quote: In Setting A, NeuroAct’s 80.88 macroaverage exceeds BrainAgent’s 63.13 by 17.75 points.

summary: NeuroAct automates evidence-guided EEG analysis, model refinement and cross-task experience reuse, and raises balanced accuracy over BrainAgent and registered recipes; its mechanism and experience-transfer studies show score and token gains but no named time series obstacle is isolated.
